_doc: The supply layer (world v86) — 'the back door.' Registry of the offstage wholesale and trade suppliers whose trucks make the neighborhood legible: who restocks what, through which door, in which window. Companion spec: world/suppliers.md. Internal demo: world/supply.html (inline SUP mirror, hand-synced, deep-compared by the audit supply gate). Consumers: the brain/prompt layer (delivery texture, invoice talk, back-gate presence), the crowd/wire layers (double-parked trucks, handtruck paths as street texture), the feed (feed_shapes only, kind 'venue'). Rules: suppliers are OFFSTAGE — they have no door, no POI, no interior, and are never staffed by cast ids; their names are parody-only like every business name. Runs are CONDITIONS the routine system may satisfy (a run can be late, early, or missed — the truck is texture, not a summons). Windows may precede open by up to 3h (pre-open drops are the norm) but must end before close, and must only list days the venue actually opens. Supply copy carries no prices — invoices stay offscreen; no credits, no USD. Suppliers do not enter businesses.json or the directory — they are vendors, not destinations. Valencia Growers is exempt: it IS the supplier — its upstream is farms off the map.
